spec.title: Top CGNAT users by active sessions
spec.description: Top inside hosts by active DET44 sessions. Uses only currently active sessions; top 20 are shown.

spec.title: User session utilization
spec.description: Top inside hosts by DET44 session-slot utilization. 1.0 = 100% of the 1000-session per-user capacity.

spec.title: Top CGNAT users — external hosts
spec.description: Inside hosts contacting the largest number of unique external IPs.

spec.title: DET44 user session utilization — all active users
spec.description: All active users by percentage of their DET44 capacity. Sorted by IP.

spec.title: CGNAT sessions by protocol
spec.description: Protocol classification derived from DET44 session states: TCP, UDP, ICMP, unknown.

spec.title: CGNAT protocol share
spec.description: Share of active DET44 sessions by protocol.

spec.title: Real IP session utilization
spec.description: External Real IP utilization against its theoretical DET44 session capacity.

spec.title: DET44 errors by reason
spec.description: Aggregated VPP node error counters, excluding successful packet-processing counters.

spec.title: DET44 packet processing — in2out vs out2in
spec.description: Successful DET44 packet processing rate by direction.

spec.title: DET44 translation failures
spec.description: Packets rejected because no DET44 translation was available.

spec.expr: sum by (node, reason) (rate(vpp_node_counter_total{node="det44-in2out",severity="error",reason=~"Out of ports|No translation|Unsupported protocol|unsupported ICMP type",instance=~"$instance"}[2m]))

spec.title: Node counter — Good packet processing
spec.description: Successful packet-processing counters across VPP nodes.

spec.title: Top CGNAT users by active sessions
spec.description: Top inside hosts by active DET44 sessions. Uses only currently active sessions; top 20 are shown.

spec.expr: node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance=~"$instance"} * on (instance, chip) group_left(chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{instance=~"$instance", chip_name="mlx5"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left(label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance=~"$instance"}

node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance=~"$instance"} * on (instance, chip) group_left(chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{instance=~"$instance", chip_name!="mlx5"} * on (instance, chip, sensor) group_left(label) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance=~"$instance"}

node_hwmon_temp_celsius{instance=~"$instance"} * on (instance, chip) group_left(chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{instance=~"$instance", chip_name!="mlx5"} unless on(instance, chip, sensor) node_hwmon_sensor_label{instance=~"$instance"}
